mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over the last three months signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve due to increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 60-day forward returns in tightening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last two months signals increased consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in high demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the last two months signals increased economic output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply-side improvements boost corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 60-day forward returns in high output periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% for 3 consecutive months) signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real interest rates remain low.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in low inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the last month signals increased consumer spending, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as immediate market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances despite the signal, or 5-day forward returns in high retail sales periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the last month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve due to increased economic activity.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase & UNRATE decrease in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the last two months signal a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings decline.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decrease > 1% & UNRATE increase > 0.3pp in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or 60-day forward returns in weakening economic periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
